summary: Duplicate metering charges after mid-cycle Dedicated reservation upgrade
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports apparent duplicate usage charges and an unexpected prorated credit when they upgraded to a Dedicated reservation mid-billing-cycle. Impact: BrightCart is seeing a ~22% higher invoice line for the week that includes the upgrade window; finance flagged the spike and paused payments pending investigation. Environment: Prod (us-east) — Dedicated capacity for BrightCart (org ID: bc-00421).

Observed behavior: On 2026-03-03 at ~03:12:04 UTC the customer completed a reservation upgrade (small->medium). Billing invoice for period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07 shows both: (a) a full charge for the original reservation, (b) a full charge for the new reservation for the remainder, and (c) a usage adjustment line referencing meter events labeled "kv-cache-credit" with quantities that match part of their token volume — resulting in a net charge that appears duplicated.

Expected behavior: Upgrade should generate a single prorated adjustment (credit + new charge) and usage metering should reflect only one metered event per request.

Key timestamps/sample IDs: upgrade_tx: tx-upg-20260303-0312, invoice_id: INV-20260307-BC421, sample request IDs with duplicate meter entries: req-7f4a2c3a (2026-03-03T02:49:12Z), req-7f4a2c3a-retry (2026-03-03T02:49:13Z), meter-event-ids observed: mtr-99823 and mtr-99823-dup.

Attachments: Customer provided exported invoice PDF and CSV of their request IDs for 2026-03-03 02:45–03:15 UTC.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer upgrades Dedicated reservation via Console at timestamp T. 2) A small window of routing change occurs where some traffic is routed to old ephemeral pool while new reservation is provisioning. 3) Requests during the overlap are retried once by the client due to a transient 502. 4) Billing shows both the original metering event and the retry as separate metered events and also applies the standard prorate credit + new charge lines.

Minimal repro: Simulate an upgrade during active traffic and trigger an application retry for a subset of requests; export meter events and ledger entries for the time window.
logs: Billing run logs: bill-run-20260307: matched invoice INV-20260307-BC421. Metering pipeline logs (meter-prod-2): duplicate events for request id req-7f4a2c3a recorded at 02:49:12 and 02:49:13 with different event_ids (mtr-99823, mtr-99823-dup). Router logs: routing-change at 2026-03-03T02:49:10Z. Scheduler logs: reservation-upgrade job tx-upg-20260303-0312 succeeded at 03:12:04Z. Audit traces: payment hold raised by BrightCart finance on 2026-03-09. See attached CSV in ticket for raw rows.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: duplicate meter events caused by client retries combined with a short-lived routing change during the Dedicated reservation upgrade. Billing pipeline currently deduplicates on event_id but not on request_id+timestamp; retries that produce new event_ids will be counted separately.

Action taken so far: (1) Pulled raw meter event stream for 2026-03-03 02:40–03:20 UTC and confirmed ~1,120 events where request_id appeared twice within a 2s window. (2) Cross-referenced ledger entries: matching duplicate token counts appear on ledger entries L-34219 and L-34220. (3) Reproduced similar behavior in staging by forcing a router mix version and issuing a client retry — same duplicate meter pattern seen.

Next steps proposed: (a) Apply a manual credit for the duplicated token quantity for the affected invoice and notify finance. (b) Create engineering task to extend billing dedupe window to deduplicate on (request_id, model, org_id) within a 5-minute sliding window and/or carry forward idempotency_token from API to metering events. (c) Add metrics/alert for sudden spikes in duplicated request_id ratio. Linked engineering ticket INT-4421 created for the dedupe change.

Potential risk: Changing dedupe logic must ensure legitimate retries that are billed (e.g., long-running idempotent operations) are not silently dropped — needs careful test coverage and audit logging.

resolution: Pending engineering change. Provisional action: Support applied a one-time account credit equivalent to the duplicated token charge for invoice INV-20260307-BC421 to unblock the customer. Engineering (INT-4421) will implement dedupe by request_id (5-minute window) and add unit/integration tests to validate no legitimate events are dropped. Follow-up: re-run billing reconciliation after change and produce a small postmortem. Customer to be notified when fix is deployed and reconciliation completes.
workaround: Applied manual credit to customer account and recommended BrightCart temporarily set client-side idempotency_token headers on retryable requests until billing dedupe is in place.
follow_up_actions: 1) INT-4421: implement dedupe on (request_id, org_id, model) with 5-minute sliding window. 2) Add alert for duplicate-request ratio > 1% in a 1h window. 3) Run reconciliation for invoices issued between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-07 for customers who upgraded reservations mid-cycle. 4) Update billing runbook with guidance for mid-cycle reservation upgrades.
